tier2_breaks.summary: TyKind::RawPtr(TypeAndMut<I>) split into RawPtr(I::Ty, Mutability) + TyKind::Pat(I::Ty, I::Pat) added
TyKind::FnPtr(PolyFnSig) -> FnPtr(Binder<I, FnSig<I>>) and Alias(AliasKind, ..) -> Alias(AliasTyKind, AliasTy<I>)
GlobalAlloc::Function(Instance<'tcx>) tuple variant -> struct variant Function { instance, unique }
TyKind::FnPtr split into (Binder<I, FnSigTys<I>>, FnHeader<I>); GlobalAlloc::Function removed `unique` field
rustc_target::abi extracted to extern crate rustc_abi (Abi -> BackendRepr, Aggregate -> Memory); ParamEnvAnd replaced by TypingEnv / PseudoCanonicalInput in tcx.layout_of
Callbacks::after_analysis & after_expansion changed third param from &'tcx Queries<'tcx> to TyCtxt<'tcx>; Variants::Empty added for 0-variant enums; TyKind::UnsafeBinder added
rustc_driver::RunCompiler struct removed and replaced by rustc_driver::run_compiler(&[String], &mut (dyn Callbacks + Send)); Callbacks::after_crate_root_parsing(&mut ast::Crate)
BackendRepr::Uninhabited removed (moved to LayoutData.uninhabited: bool); BackendRepr::Vector renamed to SimdVector
LayoutData.align changed from AbiAndPrefAlign to AbiAlign (removing preferred align); Variants::Multiple.tag_field changed from usize to FieldIdx
ConstValue::Slice { data: ConstAllocation, meta } changed to Slice { alloc_id: AllocId, meta }; GlobalAlloc::TypeId { ty } added
TyKind::Dynamic dropped DynKind (3-tuple -> 2-tuple); TyKind::Bound changed DebruijnIndex -> BoundVarIndexKind
rustc_driver::catch_with_exit_code return type changed from i32 to std::process::ExitCode; FieldsShape::Arbitrary memory_index replaced by inverse in_memory_order; BackendRepr::ScalableVector added
TyKind::Alias(AliasTyKind, AliasTy<I>) collapsed to Alias(AliasTy<I>); BackendRepr::ScalableVector -> SimdScalableVector
Variants::Multiple.variants changed element type from LayoutData<FieldIdx, VariantIdx> to VariantLayout<FieldIdx>
TyKind::Alias gained IsRigid marker field: Alias(AliasTy<I>) -> Alias(IsRigid, AliasTy<I>)
TyKind::FnDef wrapped GenericArgs in Binder<I, I::GenericArgs>; BackendRepr::ScalarPair(Scalar, Scalar) -> struct ScalarPair { a, b, b_offset }
mir::interpret::Scalar::Ptr(Pointer<Prov>, u8) changed pointer-size field to NonZero<u8>
rustc_driver::run_compiler renamed to compiler_entrypoint; LayoutData.align changed from AbiAlign (.abi) to Align (+ repr_c: bool)

tier4_semantic_deltas.summary: `Rvalue::CheckedBinaryOp` folded into `Rvalue::BinaryOp(AddWithOverflow|SubWithOverflow|MulWithOverflow)` + `UnOp::PtrMetadata` + `offset`/`offset_from` permits 0-byte offset on arbitrary dangling/null pointers + `Drop` always evaluates place

`StorageLive` on an already-live local changed from Immediate UB to storage refresh (deallocate + reallocate uninit); signed negative shift offsets defined via `rem_euclid`; `offset_from` allows equal addresses across allocations; `TerminatorKind::TailCall`

`raw_eq` on bytes carrying pointer provenance relaxed from UB to defined at runtime (`const-eval` still errors); `raw_eq` enforces alignment check; `UbChecks` evaluated per defining crate rather than caller crate
Typed copies strip pointer provenance on non-pointer scalar subfields (`reset_provenance`) and `Box<ZST>` validity updated for zero-sized allocation rules
`typed_swap_nonoverlapping` detects aliasing/overlap UB even for scalar immediates (previously skipped overlap check on non-memory scalar path)
Operational `f32`/`f64` `minnum`/`maxnum` NaN payload/sign made non-deterministic; `WrapUnsafeBinder`/`UnwrapUnsafeBinder` operational semantics added; slice indexing lowered via `PtrMetadata`
In-place `Move` call arguments and return-place aliasing made UB when passing identical/overlapping locals; function allocations no longer carry spurious alignment in Miri/CTFE

`StatementKind::Deinit` and `Rvalue::Len` removed from runtime MIR (`write_uninit` lowered differently); overlapping aggregate field initialization fixed; `ProjectionElem::Subtype` -> `CastKind::Subtype`
`NullOp::OffsetOf` removed and lowered to explicit compile-time constant sums; writing a `ScalarPair` resets uninitialized padding across the full destination range
`Rvalue::NullaryOp` eliminated (`SizeOf`/`AlignOf` folded to constants; `RuntimeChecks` moved into `Operand::RuntimeChecks`)
`Rvalue::ShallowInitBox` removed in favor of `write_via_move` / `write_box_via_move` intrinsics; typed copies with padding preserve byte-level mem-to-mem representation
`StatementKind::Retag` removed; `Rvalue::Use(op, WithRetag::Yes|No)` makes typed copies implicitly retag references/boxes unless marked `WithRetag::No`

`TerminatorKind::Call` operational order flipped to evaluate `destination` place BEFORE `func` and `args`; `CastKind::BoxDerefTransmute` makes invalid-`Box<T>` deref cast immediate UB; cast inputs and dereferenced pointers validated

Never type `!` stabilized (`!`-fallback on all editions) and `core::convert::Infallible = !` aliased (flipping observable runtime `TypeId::of::<Infallible>() == TypeId::of::<!>()` from `false` to `true`)

Newly constructed unions explicitly reset padding bytes to `Uninit`; `copy_nonoverlapping` checks overlap even when `src` is fully `Uninit`; `write_bytes` checks alignment; `InlineAsm` destination places evaluated before inputs; `Box<T>` inner wrapper changed from `Unique<T>` to `BoxRaw<T>`
